rv.q: Illinoise is not only a refreshing examination of what it means to be human, but the first truly unique take on the jukebox musical and the first successful iteration of a dance-driven theatrical story.
Justin Peck’s evening length ballet...has the energy of Jerome Robbins’ 'Fancy Free'
Illinoise is a cathartic experience for dance-theatre newcomers and fans alike.
Illinoise makes a striking case for how modern dance, set to contemporary music, can tell a story that speaks to generations of audiences without preaching or condescension.

cn.t: Critics hail this dialogue-free dance-musical as an innovative marvel that pushes boundaries of both dance and theater, with Justin Peck's expressive choreography bringing new theatrical possibilities to Sufjan Stevens' beloved album.
